_comment: CHURN CARD — D5 v4 ARM.  One functional key over _ft63_churn_base.json:
network.carry_invariant_innov_retap_only.  v3's corroborate is deliberately NOT armed
here — the two are ALTERNATIVE responses to the same population and v3 suppresses it one
level earlier, so arming both would leave v4 inert by construction and the arm would
measure nothing (the loader warns about exactly this).
WHAT IT DOES.  A D5 flag whose arc the raw observables MEASURED as continuous re-taps
its chord in-epoch as before, but its arc is no longer excluded from the NEXT epoch's
A_old membership — so the DD the gate just reset keeps its history instead of being
refloated from a diffuse prior.  Under a stable tree a chord arc lies in exactly one
fundamental cycle (its own), so on this population the exclusion protected no other
carried DD; it is the 97.8 % limit cycle.
WHAT IT DOES NOT DO, and why the scoping is not negotiable.  The funnel refloat is what
COMPLETES a real slip's reset: the in-epoch move is only the post-fit innovation v, which
the fold's -G'SG border term has already shrunk, and the re-established stiff carry locks
the remainder in.  Measured at 0.48 cyc residual in
tests/test_network_invariant_carry_driver.cpp GATE 10b.  So stepped and UNMEASURABLE
arcs still refloat, and so does any arc a raw detector flags in the current epoch.
Standing invariant #1 is narrowed to the diagnosed population, never removed.
THE CONTRAST WITH v3.  Same population, opposite response: v3 leaves the DD alone
(suppress the flag entirely), v4 re-centres it on the data but keeps its identity.  If
the innovation really is SH-iono / conditioning tension rather than a slip, v3 holds the
DD stiff against it and the tension has to land somewhere else; v4 lets the DD absorb it
without ratcheting.  Grading the two against the SAME base is the point of the triple.
WATCH: a run-end suppressed-kill count of 0 means no corroborated-flat flag ever reached
a carry arc — INERT, not benign (standing invariant #4).
